known_results: Published aggregate metrics, original out-of-fold predictions and scoring-only lineage omission sensitivities are known.
purpose: Verify numerical reproducibility of the exact existing ridge implementation and characterize variation across random partitions without selecting a favorable seed.
analyses: Refit all three original five-fold designs and compare every prediction with saved values within absolute tolerance 1e-6.
Report training-fold mean predictor on every original split as a diagnostic baseline; no biological features, tuning or thresholds.
Report train/test sizes, retained feature counts and train/test CC overlap for every original fold.

Refit the identical ridge pipeline for all 20 random five-fold seeds from 2026091900 through 2026091919 inclusive. Report all scores and descriptive ranges. Do not replace the primary seed with any new seed.
interpretation: Seed ranges describe random partition sensitivity, not confidence intervals or independent validation. Complete-CC allocation is unchanged. No hyperparameters or representations are optimized.
